notes: Session temperature graph: tap Graph on any session to see its CPU/GPU curves
patch_notes: Every session now keeps its temperature samples, and each history row has a Graph button that opens a small CPU/GPU line chart for that session, with the CPU and GPU warning lines drawn in so a spike's shape is visible, not just its peak. Long sessions thin their stored samples instead of growing the history file without bound, and sessions recorded before this version simply say they have no samples. 13 test rounds, all passing.
